signal: Foursquare is deprecating legacy V3 API endpoints in May 2026 and rolling out new Places API pricing on June 1, 2026, pushing customers toward its Geospatial Intelligence Platform.

email.body1:
Linda, saw Foursquare is migrating customers onto the new Places API and Geospatial Intelligence Platform as the V3 endpoints sunset.

A platform shift like that throws off a wave of expansion and re-engagement signals, but most RevOps teams cannot route them to action fast enough before they go cold. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, personalized outreach autonomously, 3-5x more meetings per rep without new headcount.

I built a signal play for Foursquare off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Linda, quick follow-up for Foursquare.

The gap between a buying signal firing and a rep acting on it is usually where measurable lift hides, and it is hard to see from inside the funnel. Tightening that latency is one of the fastest ways to move reply rates.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Linda, last bit of proof for Foursquare.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Foursquare reply rate likely compares to similar data platforms. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Linda, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If turning signals into pipeline faster is not on the RevOps roadmap this quarter, no problem at all. Mid-migration is its own kind of busy and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Foursquare either way.
